hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude && echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - session active - see SESSION_PROGRESS.md for detailed status" >> .claude/last-activity.log

batt=$(pmset -g batt 2>/dev/null); pct=$(echo "$batt" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+%' | head -1 | tr -d '%'); batt_state=$(echo "$batt" | grep -Eo 'charging|discharging|charged|finishing charge' | head -1); if [ -n "$pct" ] && [ -n "$batt_state" ] && [ "$batt_state" = "discharging" ] && [ "$pct" -lt 15 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "Battery at ${pct}% and discharging - please plug in. Work is safely committed to git and tracked in SESSION_PROGRESS.md up to this point." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
